title: Founding of Tenochtitlan
description:
In 1325, the **Aztecs** founded their capital city **Tenochtitlan** on an island in Lake Texcoco.

According to legend, the Aztecs were told by their god Huitzilopochtli to settle where they found an eagle perched on a cactus eating a snake.

Tenochtitlan grew to become one of the largest cities in the world, with a population of over 200,000. The ruins lie beneath modern-day Mexico City.
